_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 3% base rate for ±2 moves over 12h windows makes HOLD the statistically honest default in this coil — the analyst's 0-for-18 record on forced directional calls confirms that guessing here is a negative-EV bet, and neither brain has identified a confirmed breaker signal.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst predicts Disbelief (illegal 2-rung jump from Denial) while narrative implies recovery is underway; both reference the Aug 2024 bottom but disagree on whether the structural supports are actively locking in or still diverging
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows recover above 30 AND stablecoin growth flips positive AND BTC momentum 30d holds above 45 — this would confirm the Aug 2024 analog is live and justify upgrade to LONG
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows stay pinned near 0 OR VIX breaks 20 with funding spiking above 0.01% AND BTC momentum 30d rolls below 40 — this confirms stress is accelerating, not bottoming, and justifies downgrade to REDUCE or SHORT
